Legends Live: Frederick Forsyth in Conversation with Matthew Stadlen

RAF officer, MI6 spy, BBC war correspondent: the life and career of Frederick Forsyth is as thrilling as any bestseller. Join LBC Presenter Matthew Stadlen as he explores the real-life adventures that inspired The Day of the Jackal, The Odessa File and dozens of other award-winning classic tales of geopolitical intrigue.
